verdict.rationale: Exporting data in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented data-export or account-portability feature. Read-scoped API tokens and a CLI for managing resources are developer building blocks, and OpenFeature providers address SDK portability rather than exporting your data, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
